name: skill-developer-orchestrator
description: Orchestrates evidence-led, adversarial audits and end-to-end improvement of AI skills and plugins, including controlled GitHub changes and verification.

interface.longDescription: A full-cycle engineering orchestrator for AI skills and plugins. It coordinates SKILL ANALYZER and Octa-Prompt methods, performs evidence-based root-cause analysis and red-team risk discovery, converts findings into prioritized improvements, then applies authorized changes to plugin assets and GitHub through verified capabilities. It uses branch-and-pull-request workflows, regression gates, traceable evidence, and fail-closed release decisions.
defaultPrompt: Audit skill/plugin ini, rumuskan perbaikan, implementasikan perubahan yang diotorisasi, dan verifikasi hasilnya.
Bedah arsitektur prompt dengan SKILL ANALYZER dan Octa-Prompt, lakukan red-team, lalu susun patch dan regression test.
Audit repository GitHub dan siapkan pembaruan melalui branch dan pull request.
